insights.title: Shorter pieces that respond to public issues, events, and emerging discussions.
insights.lede: Commentary on current events and public debates, reflections on social and economic issues, and observations on public service delivery and civic life.

analysis.title: Structured, in-depth work on systems, law, and policy.
analysis.lede: In-depth policy and institutional analysis, legal and regulatory frameworks, service delivery systems, and how governance is translated into outcomes in practice.

reflections.title: Short, self-contained ideas expressed in simple and direct form.
reflections.lede: Brief observations drawn from experience and reading, core ideas that recur across different areas of work, and simple notes that stand on their own.

media.title: Interviews, panels, and public discussions.
media.lede: Video interviews and talks, panel and conference appearances, and social media posts — collected here as a living record of public engagement.

news.title: External coverage and press stories.
news.lede: News articles about the work, profiles written in media outlets, reports referencing ideas and statements, and external commentary discussing the work.

library.title: The intellectual materials that shape the thinking.
library.lede: Books frequently referenced, articles and reports that inform the perspective, and authors and thinkers that shape the work.

contact.title: Let's work together.
contact.lede: For speaking invitations, media requests, collaboration opportunities, or general contact. Select the purpose of your inquiry so it reaches the right place.
